cues.en: So this is how you can deploy different kinds of SAP applications.
And I hope that with this together, with all the knowledge gained throughout the course, you feel
now really confident to create SAP applications with exactly the features you need and then deploy them
in exactly the way you need.
Be that as a server side rendered application, as a pre rendered application, which is great if your
data doesn't change as often or as a normal single page application, which is great because you need
no node server, you don't need to pre render, you get always the latest data, but at the expense
of not having the best search engine optimization.
